metadata.question: Does the number of fire hotspots in the Paraná River delta from January through July 22, 2020, exceed those detected during the same period in 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: FIRMS active-fire hotspot dataset (NASA). - Date: 1-Jan through 22-Jul in 2019 and the same range in 2020. - Location: a simple polygon drawn over the Paraná River delta (≈ -32…-34°S, 58…-60°W). 2. Masking strategy: none needed (hotspots are point detections, already quality-flagged). 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check .size().getInfo(): 0 → C1. - After summing the “confidence” field (1 per hotspot) inside region, if result is None or NaN → C3. - Else compare counts and return A/B. - If counts equal, answer B (“does not exceed”). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time delta = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[-60.2,-32.1],[-58.0,-32.1],[-58.0,-33.6],[-60.2,-33.6],[-60.2,-32.1]]]) t19 = ['2019-01-01','2019-07-22'] t20 = ['2020-01-01','2020-07-22'] def count_hot(year_range): col = (ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') .filterDate(year_range[0], year_range[1]) .filterBounds(delta)) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: return 0 # each image has mask=1 at hotspot pixel; sum gives hotspot count total = col.sum().multiply(ee.Image.constant(0)).add(1).multiply(col.sum()).rename('sum') val = total.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=delta, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('sum').getInfo() return 0 if val is None else int(val) h19 = count_hot(t19) h20 = count_hot(t20) print(f"2019 hotspots: {h19}") print(f"2020 hotspots: {h20}") if h20 is None or h19 is None: print("C3") elif h20 > h19: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
delta = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[-60.2,-32.1],[-58.0,-32.1],[-58.0,-33.6],[-60.2,-33.6],[-60.2,-32.1]]])
t19 = ['2019-01-01','2019-07-22']
t20 = ['2020-01-01','2020-07-22']

def count_hot(year_range):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS')
             .filterDate(year_range[0], year_range[1])
             .filterBounds(delta))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    # each image has mask=1 at hotspot pixel; sum gives hotspot count
    total = col.sum().multiply(ee.Image.constant(0)).add(1).multiply(col.sum()).rename('sum')
    val = total.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                             geometry=delta,
                             scale=1000,
                             maxPixels=1e9).get('sum').getInfo()
    return 0 if val is None else int(val)

h19 = count_hot(t19)
h20 = count_hot(t20)
print(f"2019 hotspots: {h19}")
print(f"2020 hotspots: {h20}")
if h20 is None or h19 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif h20 > h19:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
